title: 实现 Core 业务角色、scope、Developer App 与 PAT 生命周期
objective: 按 Core 开发计划固定顺序第 4 步，以契约先行方式完整实现业务角色、授权 scope、Developer App 与只保存哈希的 PAT 生命周期，其中 PAT 默认最长有效期为 30 天（Q-007 已由项目所有者于 2026-10-03 决策）。
in_scope: Contracts 先行锁定 Core 0.1.0-alpha.2：Developer App、scope 词汇与 PAT 生命周期的新公共表面，含显式 4xx、唯一 operationId、对 0.1.0-alpha.1 的兼容性分类与机器校验脚本演进
GET /v1/me 保持既有 OIDC 语义并新增 personal access token 替代认证方式（兼容新增，不改变 alpha.1 字段与响应）
Core 前向只增迁移：McPlanUser 业务角色列、developer_apps 与 personal_access_tokens 表（PAT 只存 HMAC 哈希与标识前缀，不存明文）
Core authorization 模块：请求主体解析（OIDC 与 PAT 双通道）、scope 目录与资源无关的 scope/角色策略
Core developer-app 模块：应用登记、回调地址校验（生产 HTTPS 精确匹配、开发回环豁免）、scope 审批与撤销、机密客户端密钥只显示一次
Core token-metadata 模块：PAT 签发（scope 不得超出创建者当前 scope、默认最长 30 天）、元数据列举、撤销、过期强制、最后使用时间记录
高风险写入（应用创建、扩权、撤销、PAT 创建与撤销）沿用 CORE-002 的事务审计与内部 outbox 模式
Foundation memory/open-questions.md 记录 Q-007 已决（30 天，项目所有者，2026-10-03）
Developer App 的 Keycloak OIDC 客户端自动下发边界如实记录：本轮 Ops 只读，realm 无 Core 管理服务客户端，自动下发顺延到后续需要 Ops 配合的切片
out_of_scope: 每日权益、积分账本、奖励、退款、计费或完整审计/outbox 发布验收（开发计划第 5-7 步）
SDK 生成与消费者实现、Community/Skin/Official 集成
管理员管理接口与角色分配公共接口（未获授权；本切片角色经数据库设置并在测试中验证）
决定 Q-003/Q-004/Q-006 等其他产品值，或生产域名、邮件、密钥
修改 MCP-F1-SKIN-008 的分支、记录或运行环境
创建远程仓库、推送或部署
contract_impact: compatible prerelease addition: Contracts locks Core 0.1.0-alpha.2 with new Developer App, PAT and scope surfaces before producer implementation; 0.1.0-alpha.1 fields, responses and OIDC semantics stay unchanged while GET /v1/me gains a compatible personal-access-token alternative security scheme
acceptance_evidence: Contracts Python and Redocly validation pass with the evolved machine gates for 0.1.0-alpha.2
Core format, lint, typecheck, unit, integration, end-to-end, architecture, migration, contract and build validations pass, plus the runtime image build
PAT plaintext is returned only at creation; storage keeps only HMAC hash plus prefix; revoked or expired tokens are rejected
A PAT's scopes never exceed its creator's current scopes and its validity never exceeds the decided 30-day default maximum
Business-role enforcement rejects non-DEVELOPER/non-ADMIN principals on high-risk writes with the contract ROLE_REQUIRED problem
Developer app redirect URIs enforce exact match with HTTPS or loopback development exemption and secrets are displayed exactly once
High-risk writes produce transactional audit and internal outbox records
Q-007 is recorded as decided in Foundation open questions
validation_results: Preflight verified: direction F1 primary mc-plan-core; Skills current (development 1.1.2, orchestrator 1.0.0); six repositories clean with no remotes; only other active workstream MCP-F1-SKIN-008 locks mc-plan-skin; MCP-F1-CORE-003 confirmed as the next unused Core number; mc-plan-core and mc-plan-contracts on LF worktrees with repo-local core.autocrlf=false
Coordination Start passed with Core as primary, Contracts and Foundation as the only supporting repositories, and the independent Skin-only lock unchanged

Contracts 0.1.0-alpha.2 locked before any producer work as commit 3f9e13a727f5b47aa8ca48dd86decfc54e7b2cc4: GET /v1/me gains a compatible personal-access-token security alternative; new developer-app and personal-access-token operations with developer-apps:read/manage and pat:read/manage scopes; explicit 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, 403 ROLE_REQUIRED and 404 NOT_FOUND problem semantics

Isolated Python validation passed for 15 JSON schemas/events with 15 unique ids and 3 OpenAPI documents with 23 unique operationIds, including evolved machine gates: /v1/me keeps its locked alpha.1 shape plus the PAT scheme, all nine new operations keep their exact locked security requirements, PAT create accepts only userOAuth, PAT metadata schema exposes no plaintext or hash fields, expires_in_days is machine-locked to maximum 30 and default 30, and the PAT scope enum matches the declared catalog
Redocly recommended lint passed for core.yaml, community.yaml and skin.yaml

Contract-first order preserved: Contracts lock commits 3f9e13a (initial lock) and bde4dfb (created-response schema split) precede all Core implementation commits; Contracts STATUS and the compatibility matrix were finalized afterwards as 5a4da89 with the verified producer combination

Core forward-only migration 20261003001000_developer_apps_pat adds the BusinessRole enum and role column, developer_apps and personal_access_tokens tables with a (token_prefix, token_hash) unique index; prisma validate and migration:validate passed for 3 forward-only migrations

Core implementation committed as fcae0a4 (49 files: authorization, developer-app, token-metadata modules, migration, lock manifest and tests) plus docs commit ce89a39; RequestPrincipalService dispatches by mcp_ prefix between PAT authentication and OIDC provisioning, PAT storage keeps only HMAC-SHA256 hash plus 12-char prefix, and high-risk writes append transactional audit and internal outbox records

Core pnpm format:check, lint, strict typecheck and build passed; unit suite passed 45/45 across seven files; HTTP e2e suite passed 29/29 across four files; architecture validation passed for 44 source files; test:contract passed as declared against the LF-normalized Contracts worktree with 5 locked files verified and all locked JSON Schemas validated for the new surfaces

Docker being available, the isolated PostgreSQL integration suite passed 3/3: twelve-way concurrent first login still converges to one user with role propagation, and the full app/token chain verified hash-only storage, prefix-unique lookup, last_used_at tracking, immediate rejection of expired and revoked tokens, scope ceiling, ROLE_REQUIRED and token-minting rejection, plus the exact audit action and internal outbox event sequences

Foundation commit ac7e10a records the decided Q-007 value in memory/open-questions.md: PAT default maximum validity 30 days, decided by the project owner on 2026-10-03, machine-locked in Contracts and runtime-enforced in Core

Core docker build --target runtime completed successfully with exit 0, exporting the non-root runtime image (manifest sha256:9488274103822c713502a54d231d249533f42136ef00b8660f7144d25e094e23) with the new migration and application code included

Foundation validate-workspace.ps1 passed for 6 active repositories, 111 Markdown files and 46 JSON files; test-coordination.ps1 passed all 14 cases; coordination Continue passed with the independent Skin-only lock unchanged
